name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
description: Amalia Benavides Aguirre is a vampire cartographer of the Queen's Bay Company whose map magic and visions led her from Ixalan to a life with Kellan.

timeline.summary: Amalia has a vision of sand, fire and a golden door, and a voice calls her; Clavileño wakes her before she falls from her saddle.
timeline.quote: Amalia bolted upright in her saddle, her arm aching as if she'd been pushed.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia notes the expedition's goal of finding a Temple of Aclazotz and a door that may end the Church of Dusk's schism.
timeline.quote: A Temple of Aclazotz supposedly awaited them in the depths of this continent.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito shows the expedition Tarrian's lance and journal.
timeline.quote: was wielded by Venerable Tarrian, in whose footsteps we follow.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The expedition reaches a golden door in the catacombs, but Amalia sees it is not the door from her visions.
timeline.quote: To Amalia's surprise, this was not the door in her visions.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé protests that Vito corrupts the blood rites, but backs down.
timeline.quote: You corrupt the sacred blood rites

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito sacrifices a porter on the obsidian altar.
timeline.quote: With a single swipe, Vito cut the victim's throat.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The sacrifice opens the golden door and Vito praises Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: The door groaned open.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito sees a mosaic of Aclazotz and reflects on Bartolomé and Amalia, whom he suspects of hearing Aclazotz's call.
timeline.quote: Was she, too, hearing Aclazotz calling to her?

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito orders the vampires to purge the creatures; Amalia freezes one with magic and Bartolomé beheads another with his whip.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé unfurled a whip and lashed out, wrapping it around the monster's neck.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia and the expedition reach a cavern with a lava waterfall and a deserted-looking settlement.
timeline.quote: a thunderous fall of lava cascaded down the side of a wall, bright enough to light the entire space

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A strange swordsman runs toward the vampires, pursued by pale goblin-like creatures.
timeline.quote: Someone emerged from a nearby building, chased by a half-dozen smaller figures.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia alters her map with her enchanted quill, removing part of the bridge so the pursuers fall.
timeline.quote: With a delicate scratch of her quill, Amalia changed the map, and changed the world.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito refuses to help Kellan, but Amalia takes responsibility for him and Vito grudgingly accepts.
timeline.quote: I'll take responsibility for him.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé warns Amalia not to defy Vito openly again.
timeline.quote: Do not openly defy him again

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Malamet throw the Legion, one by one, into a basin of sand that drains into a hole.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé watched as the Malamet threw his comrades into the basin of sand

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia tells Kellan to hold his breath just before sinking.
timeline.quote: Hold your breath.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Trapped in the sand, Amalia has new visions of the round glyph door, a map-like sky and a burning sphere ringed with purple-pink debris.
timeline.quote: The mysterious door, round and covered in glyphs, clearer than before.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Legion falls out of the sand into the same freshwater sea.
timeline.quote: Without warning, she hit water, her eyes flying open.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia and Kellan step through the golden door into the Core, a hollow world matching her visions.
timeline.quote: A sprawling panorama spread before, above, and around her as she stepped through the portal.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia sees the central sun ringed by metal shards, as in her vision.
timeline.quote: At the center of it all, a strange sun hovered

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Legion is locked in empty detention rooms, weapons confiscated.
timeline.quote: Even so, the Legion vampires and their few remaining servants were locked up in empty rooms, weapons confiscated, and left to await their fates.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan questions the vampires, and Amalia defends the church's blood rites, then doubts.
timeline.quote: We only feed from criminals, evil people, and we use the power of blood to help others.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan reveals he is searching for the father he has never met.
timeline.quote: I'm searching for my father

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito conjures a thick magical fog over the building.
timeline.quote: A magical fog covered the building, so thick her hand would disappear if she thrust it through the opening.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia smells blood as the starving Legion soldiers feed on their own servants.
timeline.quote: When the scent of blood reached her, Amalia feared the worst.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé makes Amalia promise to return to Queen Miralda and tell her everything if he dies.
timeline.quote: if something happens to me, you must return to Queen Miralda. Tell her everything.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia erases the wall from her map; mist rolls in and she and Kellan flee.
timeline.quote: The wall behind her vanished.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Anim brings in two prisoners, Amalia and Kellan.
timeline.quote: We found these two running from the garrison

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia says the other vampires killed their servants and the queen's emissary and are seeking Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: They killed our human servants and the queen's emissary, then escaped. They're looking for Aclazotz.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Wayta reach Quint, Amalia, Kellan and Akal, and Malcolm reports the Mycotyrant.
timeline.quote: I am Steward Akal, and you seem to have brought us more trouble.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia offers to help by using her map magic on the land.
timeline.quote: I can change the land with my map.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia carves a fissure in front of the Mycotyrant's army.
timeline.quote: a deep crevice lay in the path of the army, encircling them so retreat would be difficult.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta spots a temple of Aclazotz revealed in a sheared mountain face.
timeline.quote: Pillars of a great temple rose from the sheared mountain face.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan beheads a vampire while Amalia looks away.
timeline.quote: bringing his sword together like scissors, Kellan took off her head.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Thousand Moons find the temple empty and Aclazotz gone.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz is gone

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The eater calls Amalia a traitor for abandoning Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: Traitor. We saw you run when you were called.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia grieves Bartolomé's death and Vito's rightness about their god.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé died to protect her and Kellan, but his sacrifice was in vain.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia tells Kellan she feels she has been living a lie about her faith.
timeline.quote: I feel as if I've been living a lie.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Amalia find an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: That's it. An Omenpath.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia sends word of Aclazotz's threat home through the Queen's Bay Company.
timeline.quote: she had sent word to her family and Queen Miralda through the remaining Queen's Bay Company members of the oncoming storm Aclazotz might bring.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia chooses to leave her world with Kellan and they leap through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Without another word, they leaped through the Omenpath, and everything changed.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.quote: "I missed you, Kellan,"
